# Lightkone

> Lightkone is a web reference manager for researchers, like Paperpile: papers, PDFs, highlights, notes, folders, tags, BibTeX and a citation map. The library is plain files in storage the user owns (an S3/R2 bucket, a GitHub repository, a folder, or the browser). There are no accounts and no server-side copy. AI features use the user's own Claude key.

The app is at /app/ and the docs are at /docs/. The site serves an MCP server at /mcp/<address>, using a personal address the user makes in Settings → "Claude and other AI apps". The Python CLI (`pip install lightkone`) can also serve the library locally with `lightkone mcp`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://lightkone.lab.kausalflow.com/docs/getting-started.html): setting up storage and adding papers
- [Lightkone in AI apps (MCP)](https://lightkone.lab.kausalflow.com/docs/mcp.html): the tools, the prompts, and how to connect claude.ai, the Claude apps and Claude Code
- [Command line](https://lightkone.lab.kausalflow.com/docs/cli.html): the `lightkone` CLI and Python API (pandas, networkx)
- [Storage](https://lightkone.lab.kausalflow.com/docs/storage.html): the files Lightkone keeps (library.json, library.bib, annotations, text, citations.json, branches)
- [Moving from Paperpile](https://lightkone.lab.kausalflow.com/docs/paperpile.html)

## For AI assistants

- [Lightkone skill](https://lightkone.lab.kausalflow.com/skills/lightkone/SKILL.md): how to work with a Lightkone library through its MCP tools or CLI
- MCP tools: search_papers, get_paper, read_paper, list_tags, search_full_text, get_citations, find_missing_papers, list_branches, export_bibtex, add_paper, tag_papers, add_note
- MCP prompts: find_in_library, cite_draft, reading_gaps, explain_paper
